name: helpers_split_at_paragraph_boundary
notes: Paragraph-boundary splitter (src/gateway/platforms/platforms_helpers_md.c vs LIVE gateway/platforms/helpers.py::split_at_paragraph_boundary, len_fn=None path). Traces the fit/blank-line/sentence-newline/last-newline/force-split ladder plus head+tail values. Inputs encoded <max_chars>|<text>. REAL PARITY GAP FOUND & FIXED during gating: the C port's last-newline fallback dropped the trailing \n from head (head+tail!=text); fixed to memcpy pos+1 bytes matching LIVE text[:pos+1]. Pathological inputs where the first byte is a newline are excluded (LIVE requires pos>0 there).
